description: The face of the Ferro Fabrication Works — an open-fronted steel shed spitting the blue strobe of an arc welder, the air tasting of hot metal and flux. Offcuts and I-beam stubs are stacked like cordwood along the frontage under a hand-painted board: WE MAKE IT, WE MEND IT, WE DON'T ASK. Dray Lane runs off to the west.
name: Weld Enough Alone
